notes: EXP26007301: target assignments follow the confirmed physical plate key A = Cyclin D3, B = Cyclin E1, C = Cyclin K, D = CDK4 for plates 01 and 02. Parameter reports follow their matched original well groups; original labels are retained for traceability. Replicate 1 had reversed 02A/02B labels; replicate 2 labels match the physical plate key.

Biological replicate 2 (2026-10-15). Corrected wells imported once from the Downloads full multi-channel export. The Egnyte experiment-folder parameter report supplies 112 matching GDS rows, including reported qAC50, Activity (cmax), qualifiers, Valid and QC. A different well-level export in Downloads has the same base filename; file contents, not the filename alone, determine the report type. Independent 4PL estimates remain separate from reported values.
